title: Fine for Small Spaces
text: Fine for Small Spaces. I wanted to try this out at work, as sometimes the air goes down and it can be miserable.  Unfortunately, this is more geared toward a simple cool down but not cooling for long.  I think you get as much benefit from a nice fan.
